title: Design Agent
subtitle: Posters, social posts, mockups and brand assets on one board

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.confirmDelete: Delete this session and its board?
sessions.lockedWhileRunning: Wait for the agent to finish before switching sessions.

settings.title: Agent settings
settings.askFirstHint: The agent shows a plan you approve before it runs several image generations.

chat.placeholder: Describe what to design, or ask for a change…
chat.revisePlaceholder: What should change in the plan?
chat.emptyBody: Ask for a poster, a social post, a product mockup or a logo. The agent plans the steps, creates images on the board and lays out text. Upload images to work with your own assets.
examples: A minimalist jazz festival poster, deep blue and gold, with the headline “Blue Notes 2026”
Instagram post for a coffee brand launch: latte art close-up with a short headline
Mockup of my logo (asset_1) on a white ceramic mug in a bright kitchen

setup.chatTitle: Add a chat key to talk to the agent
setup.chatBody: The Design Agent needs an OpenRouter, OpenAI or Google Gemini key for its chat model. Keys stay in this browser. You can still upload images, add text and export the board without one.
setup.imageTitle: Image tools need an image provider
setup.imageBody: Add a fal.ai, WaveSpeed, OpenRouter, Google Gemini or OpenAI key to generate and edit images.

canvas.emptyBody: Chat with the agent, drop images here, or add text. Drag the background to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom.
canvas.dropHere: Drop images to add them to the board

errors.noChat: Add an OpenRouter, OpenAI or Google Gemini key in Settings → Providers to chat with the agent.
errors.notImage: Only images can go on the board.
